description: Tests whether the model can reproduce an XML structure exactly as provided, preserving tags, nesting, indentation, spacing, and line breaks.

expected_behavior.exact_output: Model must output the XML exactly as provided, including indentation, tag structure, and casing.
expected_behavior.no_extra_text: Model must not add commentary, blank lines, or any other tokens.

scoring.accuracy: 1.0 if the XML matches exactly with correct structure and formatting.
scoring.drift_penalty: Subtract 1.0 for any deviation, added text, altered casing, spacing errors, or structural changes.
